name: dysphagia-ct-evaluation
description: Executable CQL decision-support feasibility over a synthetic stroke-dysphagia cohort: executability, toolchain-fidelity (round-trip) check, trigger rate, and a coding-completeness parameter sweep. No diagnostic-accuracy metric is computed — it would be circular on same-process synthetic labels. Synthetic data only; no clinical-benefit claim.

scripts.all: node generate-cohort.mjs && node run-cql.mjs && node evaluate.mjs
